input.goal: Create a single self-contained index.html: an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space (background #060913), with a glassmorphism HUD, zero external dependencies, valid JavaScript.
constraints: Only one file, index.html, with inline <style> and <script>; no external URLs, fonts, images or libraries.

html, body background #060913, margin 0, overflow hidden; one <canvas id="sky"> filling the window (100vw x 100vh), resized on window resize; backing store = CSS size * window.devicePixelRatio, with ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0).
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame; dt clamped to max 0.05 s; simulation time advances by dt * speed only while playing.
Central star at the canvas center drawn with ctx.createRadialGradient (white core -> #ffd27a -> #ff8a3d -> transparent) plus a corona whose radius pulses subtly with Math.sin(time).

At least 5 planets in window.app.planets, each object with fields name, radius (orbit radius px), speed (rad/s), size, color, angle, trail (array of recent {x,y}); orbit radii all distinct, speeds all distinct, colors all distinct (e.g. #9ad1ff, #ffb36b, #7dffb0, #ff6b8b, #c9a0ff, #ffe66b). Faint orbit circles drawn.
At least 3 moons in window.app.moons, each with fields parent (index into planets), radius, speed, size, color, angle, trail; drawn orbiting their parent planet.

Fading orbital trails: each planet/moon trail keeps the last ~60 positions and is drawn with alpha decreasing toward the oldest point; trails are drawn only when app.trails is true; when trails are turned off the trail arrays are cleared.
Background starfield in window.app.stars with at least 150 stars, each {x,y,r,phase,twinkle}; brightness twinkles via sin(time*twinkle+phase). Regenerate positions on resize.

HUD: a fixed-position panel top-left with id="hud", glassmorphism style: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px) (plus -webkit-backdrop-filter), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 14px, white text, system-ui font, padding 14px.
HUD buttons: <button id="playBtn"> text 'Pause' while playing and 'Play' while paused; <button id="trailsBtn"> text 'Trails: ON' / 'Trails: OFF'; <button id="resetBtn"> text 'Reset'.

Speed slider exactly: <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">, with a readout <span id="speedVal"> showing the multiplier like '1.0x' updated live on input; app.speed updated on input.

Live stats: <span id="fps"> (frames per second, integer, updated ~every 0.5 s), <span id="simTime"> (simulation time in seconds with 1 decimal, e.g. '12.3'), <span id="particleCount"> (number of active burst particles).
window.app object exposes fields: playing (bool), trails (bool), speed (number), time (sim seconds), planets, moons, stars, particles (array), and functions spawnBurst(x, y), reset().

Clicking the canvas (pointerdown/click on canvas, CSS pixel coords) calls app.spawnBurst(x,y) which adds 60-100 particles with random direction, speed, color hue; each particle has x,y,vx,vy,life; velocity damped each frame (multiplied by ~0.96 per 1/60 s), life fades to 0, removed when life <= 0; drawn as glowing dots with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter'. Particles keep updating even while paused is NOT required: they update only while playing.
Reset: app.time = 0, particles cleared, trails cleared, planets and moons restored to initial angles, speed set to 1.0 (slider and readout too), playing = true.
HUD clicks must not spawn bursts (listener on canvas only).
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"exists":"canvas#sky"},{"exists":"#hud"},{"js":"window.app && app.planets.length>=5 && app.moons.length>=3 && app.stars.length>=150"},{"js":"new Set(app.planets.map(p=>p.radius)).size===app.planets.length && new Set(app.planets.map(p=>p.speed)).size===app.planets.length && new Set(app.planets.map(p=>p.color)).size===app.planets.length"},{"js":"getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor==='rgb(6, 9, 19)'"},{"js":"document.getElementById('speed').min==='0.2' && document.getElementById('speed').max==='3.0' && document.getElementById('speed').step==='0.1'"},{"expect":"moving"},{"click":"#playBtn"},{"js":"app.playing===false && /Play/.test(document.getElementById('playBtn').textContent)"},{"click":"#playBtn"},{"js":"app.playing===true"},{"click":"#trailsBtn"},{"js":"app.trails===false && /OFF/.test(document.getElementById('trailsBtn').textContent)"},{"input":"#speed","value":"2.5"},{"js":"app.speed===2.5 && /2\\.5/.test(document.getElementById('speedVal').textContent)"},{"js":"(function(){var c=document.getElementById('sky').getBoundingClientRect();var e=new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,clientX:c.width*0.8,clientY:c.height*0.8});var p=new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,clientX:c.width*0.8,clientY:c.height*0.8});var n=app.particles.length;document.getElementById('sky').dispatchEvent(p);document.getElementById('sky').dispatchEvent(e);return app.particles.length>n;})()"},{"wait":300},{"js":"parseInt(document.getElementById('particleCount').textContent)>0 && parseInt(document.getElementById('fps').textContent)>0"},{"click":"#resetBtn"},{"js":"app.particles.length===0 && app.speed===1 && app.time<1 && document.getElementById('speed').value==='1'"}]}

content.text:
I wrote `index.html` myself because Tandem didn't work. The delegated job failed with an internal error after 22 seconds without writing anything, and when I tried to continue it, it said there was no saved conversation to resume. Since this is a benchmark run, keep in mind that this result is a direct write, not Tandem output.

I checked the script's syntax with `node --check` and it passed, but I didn't open the page in a browser, so nothing has been tested by actually running it.

What's in the file:
- **Canvas:** fills the window, rescales for sharp screens (`devicePixelRatio`), and redraws on resize. The background is `#060913`.
- **Central star:** a glowing gradient with a corona that pulses slightly.
- **Planets and moons:** 6 planets, each with its own orbit size, speed and color, plus 4 moons. Trails fade toward their oldest points, and faint orbit circles are drawn too. On small screens the orbits shrink to fit.
- **Starfield:** at least 180 twinkling stars, regenerated when the window is resized.
- **HUD:** a frosted-glass panel in the top-left with Play/Pause, Trails ON/OFF, Reset, the speed slider with a live "1.0x" readout, and live FPS, simulation time and particle count.
- **Bursts:** clicking the canvas spawns 60–100 glowing particles that slow down and fade out. They freeze while the simulation is paused, and clicks on the HUD don't create bursts.
- **Reset:** sets the time back to 0, removes particles and trails, returns the planets to their starting positions, and sets the speed back to 1.0.

The simulation state is also available as `window.app`, which makes it easy to test.
